name: dexterm
description: Local Solana memecoin research, rug checks, LARP evidence, and holder analysis over MCP.
long_description: dexterm exposes 75 MCP tools for Solana memecoin research: token dossiers, holder analysis, security and rug checks, mechanical LARP evidence with a 0-100 LARP score, the advertised X account, candles, trades, knowledge resources, bounded app navigation, a read-only trade ledger, paper autotrade tools (strategy changes are proposals the user applies; paper runs can be listed, compared, started and stopped; paper forward tests and promotion proposals), read-only real-mode tools (the signal feed, the limits in force and a limits change it can only propose: no tool arms a strategy or sets or raises a limit), plus opt-in paper-trading tools that book simulated trades only inside a mandate the user armed. Market and web reads use public or user-configured sources and report missing data as unavailable. dexterm holds no key: no MCP tool can build, sign or send a transaction, place a live order, or change the keypress confirmation gate. The source is AGPL-3.0-only.
